ADVANCE AGENDA ITEM
  City of Westlake Village
  December 4, 2024
  Agenda Item: Consent Calendar No. 1

TO:  Mayor and City Council

FROM:  Rob de Geus, City Manager

SUBJECT: ARTERIAL SYSTEM FINANCING PROGRAM ANNUAL REVIEW

Westlake Village Municipal Code Section 7.3.100 states the Arterial System Financing
Program Annual Review Report must be posted for public review 15 days before City
Council reviews.

Attached is the report and it is posted as an Advance Agenda Item.

Prepared by:  Mark Wessel, City Traffic Engineer

Attachment:  ASFP Annual Review

241204 Staff Report - ASFP Annual Review.docx

1643628.2
   WESTLAKE VILLAGE
  ARTERIAL SYSTEM FINANCING PROGRAM
  FISCAL YEAR 2023-2024 FEE REVIEW

BACKGROUND

The Arterial System Financing Program (ASFP) was established in 1991 and last updated
in 2012. In accordance with the Mitigation Fee Act and the Traffic Impact Fee Ordinance,
this fee review provides a status report of the program and a summary of activity for Fiscal
Year 2023-2024.

FEE DESCRIPTION

The fees in the ASFP fund are traffic impact fees imposed on new development,
development expansion, and development intensification.

FEE AMOUNT

The current amount of the ASFP fee is $2,878 per PM peak hour trip generated by
proposed development.

FUND BALANCE

The balance at the beginning of the fiscal year was:  $ (446,618.70)
The balance at the end of the fiscal year was:  $ (268,788.07)

REVENUE

Fees collected during the fiscal year:  $  0.00
MTA Grant funds*:  $ 177,830.63
Interest earned during the fiscal year:  $  0.00
Total:  $ 177,830.63

EXPENDITURES

There were no expenditures during the fiscal year.

INTERFUND TRANSFERS/LOANS

There were no interfund transfers or loans to or from the ASFP fund during the fiscal year.

REFUNDS/ALLOCATIONS

There were no refunds from or allocations of the ASFP fund during the fiscal year.

* The City's Capital Improvement Program Fund provides interim funding for ASFP projects until MTA grant
funds are received.
